title: Mast May Alast
roman: Mast may alast hai woh baadshaah-e-waqt hai
Bandaah-e-dar jo hai tera woh be niyaaz bakht hai
Salley alaa muhammadin salley alaa muhammadin
Un ki gadaayi ke tufayl hum ko mili sikandari
Rang ye laayi bandagi aouj pe apna bakht hai
Salley alaa muhammadin salley alaa muhammadin
Gardish-e-dour yaa Nabi weeran dil ko kar gayi
Taab na mujh mein ab rahi dil mera lakht lakht hai
Salley alaa muhammadin salley alaa muhammadin
Jaam-e-nazar pilaaiye tishnagi mujh ko sakht hai
Salley alaa muhammadin salley alaa muhammadin
Akhtar-e-khasta Taybah ko sab chaley tum bhi ab chalo
Jazb se dil ke kaam lo utho ke waqt-e-raft hai
Salley alaa muhammadin salley alaa muhammadin
